{{Short description|American physicist and academic}}
'''William Skocpol''' (born 1946 in [[Akron, Ohio]]) is an American [[physicist]] of [[Czech Americans|Czech ancestry]] and an [[emeritus]] academic at [[Boston University]].

== Biography ==
He grew up in [[Crete, Nebraska]] from 1948 to 1957 and [[Richardson, Texas]] from 1957 to 1964. He graduated with a BA in physics from [[Michigan State University]] in 1968, with an MA in physics from [[Harvard University]] in 1971 and a PhD from Harvard in 1974.<ref name="BU">{{citation |title=William Skocpol |publisher=Boston University |access-date=11 August 2025 |url=https://www.bu.edu/physics/profile/william-skocpol/ |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250119094512/https://www.bu.edu/physics/profile/william-skocpol/ |archive-date=19 January 2025 |url-status=live}}</ref>

He worked as junior faculty at Harvard University from 1969 to 1980, at [[Bell Labs|AT&T Bell Labs]] in [[Holmdel Township, New Jersey|Holmdel, New Jersey]] from 1980 to 1987, and at Boston University from 1987 to 2014.<ref name="BU" />

He was elected Fellow of the [[American Physical Society]] in 1987.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.aps.org/programs/honors/fellowships/archive-all.cfm?initial=S&year=2016&unit_id=&institution=Boston+University|title=William Skocpol|website=aps.org|publisher=[[American Physical Society]]|accessdate=April 27, 2017|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170429092613/https://www.aps.org/programs/honors/fellowships/archive-all.cfm?initial=S&year=2016&unit_id=&institution=Boston+University|archive-date=29 April 2017|url-status=dead}}</ref>

He married the sociologist [[Theda Skocpol|Theda Barron]] in 1967; they have a son, Michael, born in 1988.<ref name="BU" />
